p: ninth year of his reign: That is, of Zedekiah.
tenth month: Which the Hebrews call Teber, and it contains part of December and part of January.
prevailed in the city: So much that the mothers ate their children, La 4:10.
gate between two walls: Which was a back door, or some secret gate to leave by.
gave judgment upon him: Or, condemned him for his perjury and treason, 2Ch 36:13.
seventh day of the month: Jeremiah writes in Jer 52:12 the tenth day, because the fire continued from the seventh day to the tenth.
fell away to the king of: While the siege endured.
second priest: That is, one appointed to act in the place of the high priest, if he were sick or otherwise detained.
five men of them that were: Jeremiah makes mention of seven but here he speaks of those who were the chiefest.
sware to them: That is, he exhorted them in the Name of the Lord, according to Jeremiah's counsel, to submit themselves to Nebuchadnezzar, seeing it was the revealed will of the Lord.
Egypt: Contrary to Jeremiah's counsel in Jeremiah 40-42.

Jehoiachin king of Judah: This long were he, his wife and his children in Babylon, whom Nebuchadnezzar's son after his father's death preferred to honour: thus by God's providence the seed of David was preserved even to Christ.
allowance was a continual allowance given: Meaning, that he had standing in the court.
